negativeControls.defaultOff: ENABLE_AI_TASKS_WORKER absent or false creates zero receipt/event state; scheduler and worker use the same flag.
negativeControls.concurrency: Eight same-key calls converge on one receipt/job; two simultaneous redrive operators create one REDRIVEN event.
negativeControls.payloadCollision: Same tenant/key with a changed payload digest is rejected.
negativeControls.tenantIdentity: Receipt claim binds organization, user, plan and digest; foreign tenant fails closed and a second tenant is independent.
negativeControls.redisDown: Literal stopped Redis returns one recoverable PENDING receipt and no false success; recovery uses the identical receipt and becomes ENQUEUED.
negativeControls.crashRestart: Expired RUNNING lease is reclaimed by a new worker and cold-read terminal state is durable.
negativeControls.deadLetter: Linked Bull work exhausts three attempts into durable FAILED; operator redrive succeeds on attempt four.
negativeControls.appendOnly: Literal UPDATE and DELETE of ai_agent_job_attempts are rejected by PostgreSQL.

rollback.method: Revert integrated AGT product commits while retaining additive receipt/attempt tables for forensic compatibility. Keep ENABLE_AI_TASKS_WORKER OFF and never delete attempt history.
rollback.invalidation: Requalify if queue envelope, planner contract, identity model, retry policy, lease, enable flag, migration order or Redis topology changes.
